text:
Jordan: Quick kickoff for the May livestream. thinking shorter keynote + 3 micro-breakouts to improve handoff to SDRs. open to title ideas.
Anya: Love that. keeps attention high and increases targeted follow-ups. :sparkles:
Sam: Suggested breakouts: cost & batching; private deployment & compliance; observability & evals.
Mira: Yeah - each should be demo-forward. 12m content + 3m q sounds tight but doable.
Jordan: Draft run-of-show:```
00:00 Intro (Jordan) 4m
04:00 Keynote (Anya) 18m
22:00 60s pitch per breakout (hosts) 3m
25:00 Breakouts (A/B/C) 15m
40:00 Regroup: top takeaways 6m
46:00 Live panel Q&A 10m
56:00 Close & CTA 4m
```
Kai: good. for breaks we need one slide prompt + 30s demo clip per room. I can produce short clips.
Anya: Speakers: keynote=Anya, breakout A=Sam (cost), B=Mira (private), C=Jordan (obs). Confirm rehearsal Thu 9am PT?
Sam: Confirmed.
Mira: Confirmed.
Jordan: Confirmed.
ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal event created for 2025-05-15T16:00Z and resource doc posted in #marketing-resources.
Anya: Tech checklist: slides uploaded 24h before, test share + mic, demo staging endpoint, ephemeral keys, recording turned on.
Sam: @Kai can you reserve a staging slot with slightly higher throughput and KV cache enabled for demos?
Kai: Done. endpoint: https://staging.redwood-demo/5209, ephemeral key will be handed out at rehearsal.
Mira: For private demo we need sanitized dataset. @Jordan can you scrub and share?
Jordan: Will scrub and drop in drive by EOD tomorrow.
Anya: Registration: add breakout choice dropdown (cost | private | observability). route leads based on selection to respective SDR.
Sam: CTA blurbs: "Cut token spend by 3x with smarter batching"
Mira: "Run inference in your VPC with audit-grade controls"
Jordan: "Catch regressions early with prompt-driven evals"
Anya: I'll draft landing copy + two social variants once CTAs are final. target: lock Monday.
Sam: Rehearsal failover: if streaming stalls, play pre-recorded 90s clip, note in runbook.
Mira: Also need a Q-triage plan in each room; collect top 3 questions for the panel.
Jordan: Assigning triage: Sam room A, Mira room B, Kai room C logistics, Anya panel moderator.
ops-bot: Recording enabled. post-event recording will be stored in Marketing Drive.
Anya: Please submit 40-word bios + headshots by Monday so I can build slides.
Sam: Sending mine now.
Mira: Sending tonight.
Jordan: Scrubbed dataset + bio tomorrow morning.
Kai: I'll standby for any deploy/endpoint hiccups during rehearsal.
Anya: Rehearsal agenda: 10m tech check, 10m mock intros, 20m demo dry-run, 15m breakout timing run, 5m contingency.
Jordan: Thanks all 680 will update run-of-show doc and ping when slide folder is live.
